English.Char_Desc_2000:
yyzTools is a free Windows desktop productivity toolkit that bundles 40+ everyday tools into one installer: command palette, translation, OCR, file search and preview, clipboard history, batch processing, screen capture and recording, live wallpaper and more. It is local-first and free forever.
CmdPlate is the hub: press Alt+Space to open one input over apps, files, processes, windows, bookmarks and clipboard history. Type a prefix to switch domains (f files, p processes, w windows, b bookmarks, c clipboard, > commands, = instant calculation). File search runs on an in-house full-disk indexing engine with a small memory footprint.
Built-in tools cover text and language (multi-engine translation, offline OCR via the local RapidOCR engine, regex tester, encode/decode, MD5/SHA hashes, encryption, JSON/YAML/XML/TOML/CSV conversion), files and media (preview Office documents, PDF, images, video and archives without Office; batch rename; batch image, video and PDF processing via ImageMagick, FFmpeg, pdfcpu and Ghostscript; multi-threaded downloads), efficiency (edge dock, usage charts, screen recorder with camera auto-zoom, reminders, calendar, system quick actions) and personalisation (live web/video wallpaper beneath the desktop icon layer, desktop effects, a customisable new-tab page).
Extensibility: 379 built-in .zenmod command modules across AI, apps, games, system and web; drop a JSON file into the Modules folder to add your own command, no build step required. SDK documentation and a sample project are free.
Privacy: clipboard history, file search, usage stats and OCR are processed and stored locally. No sign-up, no collection of personal data; online features run only when invoked. Open-source components are MIT licensed. Available in 12 languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Russian, Arabic and Portuguese.
